revision: Wireframe revision 1 (Nimish, 9 Nov 2026, issue #546): one more generous spacing scale
supersedes: the space-1 to space-7 of tokens.json (4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64), in the wireframe kit and in DESIGN.md. tokens.json is untouched on purpose: apps/web/design-system/tokens.json must stay byte for byte equal to it (specs/UI-14), and this revision changes no app code. When the site adopts revision 1, a builder copies these values into tokens.json `spacing` and runs `node apps/web/scripts/tokens.mjs`; this file is then deleted and kit.mjs reads tokens.json again.
